Container.Name: chs-tile-proxy
Container.Overview: Caching XYZ tile proxy for Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) ENC nautical charts. Exposes /tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png suitable for Gaia GPS and other slippy-map clients. Tiles are fetched on demand from the CHS MapServer and cached to disk.
Container.Description:
Caching XYZ tile proxy for Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) ENC nautical charts. Tiles are fetched on demand and cached to disk so repeated views of the same area do not hit the upstream service.
Use the URL `http://<NAS-IP>:8001/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png` as a custom map source in Gaia GPS.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the tile server listens on.

Config.Name: Tile Cache
Config.Description: Directory where rendered tiles are cached. Persist this to avoid re-fetching after a container restart.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Python log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

Config.Name: Max Zoom
Config.Description: Maximum tile zoom level the server will fetch. Higher values waste cache for over-zoomed scales.

Config.Name: CHS Layers
Config.Description: Which ENC layers to render. Defaults to the visible chart layers (skips data-quality hatching).

Config.Name: Upstream Timeout (s)
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for the CHS service before failing a tile request.
